verdict.rationale: The only relevant evidence is a community post quoting Morph's privacy policy: Free Tier code 'may' be used to train models, while the Enterprise Tier states submitted code is not used for anything beyond the immediate request. That suggests opting out of training is possible only by moving to Enterprise, and the poster flags ambiguity about whether non-enterprise paying users are trained on. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a training opt-out, a self-serve opt-out control outside Enterprise, clarity for paid non-enterprise tiers, and a data-retention policy.
